correctness.rationale: In the weighted projective plane P(1,1,2), all odd degree k=2r+1 monomials x^p y^q a^j have p+q+2j=k. Eliminating p gives full lattice points (q,j) in trapezoid conv((0,0),(k,0),(1,r),(0,r)). The four primitive inward normals (1,0),(0,1),(-1,-2),(0,-1) have adjacent determinants 1; the extra ray resolves the unique determinant-two cone, giving a -2 exceptional section and smooth toric surface F_2. All weighted odd-degree monomials vanish only at [0:0:1] and the full polytope linear system embeds resolved F_2. Normalized area 2Area=(k²−1)/2. Independently checked all fan determinants, ray relation and area symbolically and for r=1..19; no issue with stated restricted geometric result.
